description: Road Segment is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Perth. This dataset shows polygon locations of the road segments inventoried by the City of Perth. The road segment data was collected from as constructed drawings and old survey maps. At least 95% of the locational data for the road segment is accurate to within a few meters. Some errors and/or duplicate data may exist. Coverage: City of Perth. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher City of Perth. Its tags are 3857, AMU, Assets, EPSG 3857, PV - Public View. It offers 1 resource(s) in OTHER. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
